title.zh: 废止对工会官员作出非颠覆性宣誓的要求，为此废止第875号共和国法第23条第（b）目第（2）项的法案
title.en: An Act Abolishing the Requirement of Non-Subversive Affidavits by Officers of Labor Organizations, Repealing for the Purpose Subparagraph (2), Subsection, (b), Section Twenty-Three of Republic Act Numbered Eight Hundred Seventy-Five

text.en: Subparagraph (2), subsection (b) of Section twenty-three of Republic Act Numbered Eight hundred seventy-five, entitled "an Act to promote industrial peace and for other purposes," requiring non-subversive affidavits by all the officers of every labor organization, association or union is hereby repealed. All other provisions in said Republic Act referring to such non-subversive affidavits are likewise hereby repealed.

All Acts, parts of Acts, and regulations inconsistent with this Act are hereby repealed.
Approved: June 15, 1968.
